children.name: Cladtertia
children.description: A placozoan genus described in 2022 from a cryptic species complex, identified through genomic analysis.

children.name: Cladtertia collaboinventa
children.description: A cryptic placozoan species distinguished from Trichoplax adhaerens by genomic analysis in 2022. Its discovery raised the number of recognized placozoan species to four.
